{{Quote|Get her!|The Utai, on Aurra Sing|<ref name="Night" />}}
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Utai/Legends|Utai]] was a '''patron''' of the [[Quarek'k]], a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] complex located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The Utai, a [[Unidentified Zabrak patron|Zabrak]], and a [[Unidentified Shistavanen|Shistavanen]] were [[Alcohol/Legends|drinking]] together there when the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] entered. The trio tried to get her to consort with them, but she refused and eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Shistavanen and Utai, [[Sai tok/Legends|slicing]] the latter in half with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You're a real hard case.''"<br />"''Funny, that's what the pubtender said. Maybe I need to change my hairstyle.|The Utai and Aurra Sing|<ref name="Night" />}}
Soon after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was [[Declaration of a New Order|founded]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' states that the Empire was founded in 19 BBY. Per the prologue of ''Streets of Shadows'', the book takes place the same year and the Empire has already risen. Furthermore, it takes place not long after the first ''Coruscant Nights'' [[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight|novel]], which is set directly afterward.</ref> a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Utai/Legends|Utai]] was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He was [[Alcohol/Legends|drinking]] heavily alongside two companions&mdash;a [[Unidentified Zabrak patron|Zabrak]] and a [[Unidentified Shistavanen|Shistavanen]]&mdash;in [[Section 7-B]] of a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] complex called the [[Quarek'k]] when a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] entered the establishment. The trio decided to proposition the woman, so they cornered her and the Zabrak tried to convince her to consort with them. After Sing [[Cho mok/Legends|cleaved]] the Zabrak's [[Limb/Legends|arm]] off with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], the Utai jumped to his companion's aid with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]]. He was quickly [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Sing, who [[Sai tok/Legends|vertically bisected]] him, alongside the Shistavanen.<ref name="Night" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Maybe you should be more polite.''"<br />"''That's right. Be a shame to see a pretty snowflake like you get hurt when all we want is some nice.|The Utai and his Zabrak companion, to Aurra Sing|<ref name="Night" />}}
The Utai was large and stocky for his [[Species/Legends|species]]. When drunk, he had no qualms about trying to solicit Sing with his companions even though she was of a [[Near-Human|different]] species. When the Zabrak was injured, the Utai immediately came to to his companion's defense with a lethal weapon.<ref name="Night" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Utai appeared briefly in the second novel of the [[Star Wars: Coruscant Nights|''Coruscant Nights'' trilogy]], ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', written by [[Michael Reaves]] and released in [[2008]].

==Appearances==
